name: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited
blurb: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited is an Australian defence and space technology company specialising in electro-optic systems, remote weapon stations, and space domain awareness. Its defence segment produces automated and remotely operated weapons systems used by military forces, while its space segment develops laser-based systems for tracking and communicating with satellites and space debris. The company operates primarily in Australia, the Middle East, and other international defence markets. With a market capitalisation of approximately A$1.63 billion, EOS has grown into one of Australia's more prominent listed defence contractors.
